objective: sanity-check cached-native VoxTell v123 fine-tuning against exp003 v123 and measure decoder-high-LR stability

initialization.load_policy: load public model weights directly; do not initialize from exp003 or exp004 fine-tuned checkpoints

preprocessing.normalization: orientation fix, crop-to-nonzero, full cropped-volume z-score once, then native-resolution patch/window sampling
preprocessing.scientific_difference_from_exp003_v123: none intended; this replaces on-the-fly preprocessing with cached arrays

schedule.prompt_policy: multi-finding 2 positive + 1 negative; one-finding 1 positive + 2 negatives; every selected positive nonempty in its sampled patch

shared_training.augmentation: none added beyond VoxTell patch sampling

v123_cached_e7_d6.purpose: cached-native reproduction sanity check for the exp003 v123 recipe

v123_cached_e7_d4.purpose: decoder LR effect with a frozen-ish encoder

v123_cached_e6_d4.purpose: moderate encoder adaptation with high decoder LR

validation.eval_policy: sidecar coordinator only; fixed JSONs are passed directly and --limit is forbidden

differences_from_exp003_v123: Initialization remains public VoxTell v1.1, matching exp003 full runs.
The native preprocessing is cached-equivalent instead of recomputed on the fly.
Epoch-5 evaluation is from the same continuous 100-epoch run instead of a separate 5-epoch diagnostic run.
Three arms raise decoder LR to 1e-4 and vary encoder LR.
differences_from_voxtell_pretraining: Training uses ReXGroundingCT text prompts and released 4D finding masks.
One-finding cases use the 1 positive + 2 negative fallback prompt policy.
Fine-tuning uses batch size 1, 100 optimizer updates per epoch, and the v123 empty-target/weighted-BCE loss.
Validation uses fixed val20 and val200 JSON probe sets.
